title: Mandatory Call Disclosures & Conduct Rules (Compliance)
content: Compliance Dept. | Version 1.4 | Dated 2024-03-01 | Applies to all outbound and inbound tele-sales calls, including AI voice agents.

title: Mandatory Call Disclosures & Conduct Rules (Compliance) > Mandatory Disclosures
content:
1. **Identity & purpose** (start of call): State the agent's name, that the call is from Sentinel Health Insurance, and the purpose of the call.
2. **Call recording consent** (start of call): "This call is being recorded for quality and training purposes." Proceed only if the customer does not object.
3. **Solicitation statement** (before any product discussion): "Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation."
4. **Waiting period disclosure** (before discussing or quoting a plan): State the 30-day initial waiting period, the pre-existing disease waiting period applicable to the plan, and the 24-month specific-illness waiting period.
5. **Premium disclaimer** (whenever a premium figure is mentioned): Premium is indicative, exclusive of 18% GST, and subject to underwriting.
6. **Eligibility disclaimer** (whenever eligibility is discussed): Eligibility is preliminary and subject to underwriting; no guarantee of acceptance.
7. **Free-look period** (when the customer agrees to proceed): 30-day free-look from receipt of policy document.

title: Mandatory Call Disclosures & Conduct Rules (Compliance) > Prohibited Statements (risky Statements)
Mandatory Call Disclosures & Conduct Rules (Compliance) > Data Handling
content:
- Collect only the data required for qualification: name, age or date of birth, city/PIN, number and age of members, declared health conditions, contact number, preferred callback time.
- Do not ask for or record card numbers, bank passwords, OTPs, or Aadhaar numbers on a sales call.
- Transcripts stored for training must have PII masked.

title: Mandatory Call Disclosures & Conduct Rules (Compliance) > Do-not-call
content: If the customer asks not to be contacted again, acknowledge, stop the pitch, and mark the lead DNC. Do not attempt to retain.

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales
content:
Sales Enablement | Version 2024.1 | Last reviewed 2024-02-15
Approved responses only. Agents must not invent statistics, promise approvals, or disparage competitors. Where a customer asks something not covered here or in the product documents, say you will check and arrange a callback from a human advisor.

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "It Is Too Expensive."
content:
Approved response: Acknowledge, then reframe to daily cost and risk. "I understand - let me put it in perspective. For a 30-year-old, Sentinel Essential with 5 lakh cover costs around Rs 7,200 a year, which is about Rs 20 a day. A single day in an ICU in a metro hospital costs Rs 25,000 to 40,000." Then offer levers: lower sum insured, Essential instead of Family Shield, Zone B discount if applicable, 2-year policy discount of 5%, monthly payment mode.
Do not: offer discounts that are not on the rate card.

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "I Already Have Cover From My Employer."
content: Approved response: "That is a great start. Employer cover ends when you change jobs or retire, and most group plans are Rs 3 to 5 lakh shared across the family. A personal policy bought while you are young keeps waiting periods served and locks in lifetime renewability. Many customers keep both - the personal policy as a top-up."

source.locator: Objection: "I Already Have Cover From My Employer."

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "I Am Young And Healthy, I Do Not Need It."
content: Approved response: "That is exactly the best time to buy - premiums are lowest, no medical tests are needed below 45, and your waiting periods get completed before you are likely to need a claim. Accidents and dengue do not check age."

source.locator: Objection: "I Am Young And Healthy, I Do Not Need It."

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "Insurance Companies Always Reject Claims."
content:
Approved response: "I understand the concern. Sentinel's claim settlement ratio for FY 2023-24 was 96.4%, and we process claims in-house without a TPA. The main reason claims are rejected anywhere is non-disclosure of a pre-existing disease, so I will make sure your medical history is recorded accurately today."
Do not: claim 100% settlement or say claims are "never" rejected.

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "I Need To Discuss With My Spouse / Family."
content: Approved response: Agree and schedule. "Of course. Can I send a summary on WhatsApp or email so you can discuss it together, and call you back at a time that suits you both?" Capture a callback slot.

source.locator: Objection: "I Need To Discuss With My Spouse / Family."

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "I Have Diabetes / BP, I Will Probably Be Rejected."
content: Approved response: "Controlled diabetes and blood pressure are accepted by Sentinel in most cases, with a waiting period of 36 months for those conditions and a small loading on the premium. Everything else - accidents, infections, other illnesses - is covered after the initial 30 days. I cannot confirm acceptance on the call; the underwriting team decides after your health declaration and, if needed, a free medical test."

source.locator: Objection: "I Have Diabetes / BP, I Will Probably Be Rejected."

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "Waiting Periods Are Too Long."
content: Approved response: "Waiting periods are standard across the industry and are regulated. The initial 30-day wait does not apply to accidents. If you are porting from another insurer, the waiting periods you have already completed carry forward."

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "I Will Buy Later."
content: Approved response: "Premiums rise with every age band and any new diagnosis in the meantime becomes a pre-existing disease with a 3-year wait. Buying today locks in your current health status." Offer to send the quote and schedule a follow-up.

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Objection: "Why Not Buy Online Directly / From A Competitor?"
content: Approved response: Do not disparage competitors. "You can absolutely compare. What our customers value is in-house claims with 2-hour cashless approval, the restoration benefit, and lifetime renewability. I am happy to send you the policy wording so you can compare clause by clause."

source.locator: Objection: "Why Not Buy Online Directly / From A Competitor?"

title: Objection Handling Playbook - Health Insurance Tele-Sales > Escalation Triggers
content:
Transfer to a human advisor (or schedule a callback from one) when the customer:
- explicitly asks for a human or a manager,
- raises a complaint about an existing claim or policy,
- asks for legal or tax advice beyond the Section 80D statement,
- asks about a product, discount or rule that is not in the knowledge base,
- becomes distressed or repeatedly frustrated.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Family Shield - Policy Wording
content: Sentinel Family Shield - POLICY WORDING UIN: SENHLIP24001V012324 | Version 1.2 | Effective 2024-04-01

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Definitions
content: A.1 "Hospital" means an institution registered with local authorities having at least 10 in- patient beds (15 in towns with population above 10 lakh), qualified nursing staff round the clock, a qualified medical practitioner in charge round the clock, and a fully equipped operation theatre. A.2 "pre-existing disease" means any condition, ailment, injury or disease that is diagnosed by a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date of the policy, or for which medical advice or treatment was recommended by or received from a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Definitions > "Co-payment" Means A Cost-sharing Requirement Under Which The Policyholder Bears A
content: A.3 "co-payment" means a cost-sharing requirement under which the policyholder bears a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount. A co-payment does not reduce the sum insured. A.4 "Grace Period" means the specified period of time immediately following the premium due date during which a payment can be made to renew or continue the policy without loss of continuity benefits. Grace period is 30 days for annual, half-yearly and quarterly modes and 15 days for monthly mode. A.5 "Day Care Treatment" means medical treatment or surgical procedure undertaken under general or local anaesthesia in a hospital or day care centre in less than 24 hours because of technological advancement.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Coverage
content: B.1 In-patient Hospitalisation: reasonable and customary charges for room, boarding, nursing, ICU, surgeon, anaesthetist, consultants, operation theatre, medicines, diagnostics, and implants, for hospitalisation of at least 24 consecutive hours. B.2 Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before admission and Post- hospitalisation expenses up to 90 days after discharge, related to the same illness.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Coverage > Day Care Treatment: All Day Care Procedures Are Covered.
content: B.3 Day Care Treatment: all day care procedures are covered.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Coverage > Road Ambulance: Up To Rs 3,000 Per Hospitalisation.
content: B.4 Road Ambulance: up to Rs 3,000 per hospitalisation. B.5 AYUSH Treatment: in-patient treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy at a government hospital or an institute recognised by the government, up to the sum insured. B.6 Restoration of Sum Insured: if the sum insured and accrued no-claim bonus are exhausted during a policy year, 100% of the base sum insured is restored once in that year, usable only for an illness unrelated to those for which claims were already paid. Restored amount cannot be carried forward. B.7 no-claim bonus: 10% of base sum insured for every claim-free policy year, cumulative to a maximum of 50%. In a year with a claim the bonus reduces by 10%, never below zero. B.8 Maternity: delivery expenses including pre-natal and post-natal expenses up to Rs 50,000 per delivery, maximum two deliveries during the lifetime of the policy, available after 24 months of continuous coverage of both the mother and the father. Newborn is covered under this limit from birth until 90 days, and may be added as an insured member from day 91.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Coverage > Road Ambulance: Up To Rs 3,000 Per Hospitalisation.
content: B.9 Annual health check-up: one preventive check-up per insured adult per policy year after the first year, at Sentinel network diagnostic centres.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Waiting Periods > Initial Waiting Period: 30 Days From The First Policy Start Date For Any Illness. Not
content: C.1 Initial waiting period: 30 days from the first policy start date for any illness. Not applicable to accidental injuries. C.2 pre-existing disease waiting period: 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. C.3 Specific illness waiting period: 24 months for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, fissure, fistula, sinusitis, benign prostatic hypertrophy, joint replacement unless due to accident, uterine fibroids, kidney stones, gall bladder stones, varicose veins, and tonsillectomy.

title: Sentinel Family Shield - Policy Wording > Waiting Periods > Maternity Waiting Period: 24 Months.
content: C.4 Maternity waiting period: 24 months. C.5 Waiting periods already served under a previous indemnity health policy are credited on portability as per IRDAI guidelines.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal)
content: Document owner: Underwriting | Version 3.2 | Effective 2024-04-01 | Supersedes v3.1 (Oct-2023)

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Entry Age
content:
- Essential and Family Shield: adults aged 18 to 65 years at policy start. Dependent children: 91 days to 25 years.
- Senior Care: 61 to 80 years at entry.
- Note (legacy text retained from v2.0): "Essential plan entry age is 18 to 60 years." -- THIS LINE IS OUTDATED, see rule above.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Medical Underwriting Triggers
content:
A pre-policy medical examination (pre-policy medical examination) is required when ANY of the following is true:
1. Proposer or any insured adult is above 45 years of age.
2. Any pre-existing disease is declared.
3. BMI is below 17 or above 32.
4. Sum insured requested is Rs 25 lakh or more.
5. Plan is Senior Care (always).
pre-policy medical examination is arranged at a Sentinel-empanelled diagnostic centre at Sentinel's cost. If the proposal is not accepted, Sentinel still bears the test cost.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Pre-existing Disease (PED) Acceptance Grid
content:
Hypertension, controlled on <=2 drugs - Decision: Accept; Loading: 10%; pre-existing disease waiting: 36 months (12 months Senior Care).
Type 2 diabetes, HbA1c < 8, no complications - Decision: Accept; Loading: 10-25% by age; pre-existing disease waiting: 36 months (12 months Senior Care).
Type 2 diabetes with complications, or Type 1 / insulin-dependent - Decision: Refer to underwriter; Loading: case basis; pre-existing disease waiting: -.
Asthma, mild, no hospitalisation in 2 years - Decision: Accept; Loading: 0-10%; pre-existing disease waiting: 36 months.
Thyroid disorder on medication - Decision: Accept; Loading: 0%; pre-existing disease waiting: 36 months.
Cancer, any history within 5 years - Decision: Decline; Loading: -; pre-existing disease waiting: -.
Heart attack / bypass / angioplasty - Decision: Decline (Essential, Family Shield); Refer (Senior Care); Loading: -; pre-existing disease waiting: -.
Chronic kidney disease stage 3+ - Decision: Decline; Loading: -; pre-existing disease waiting: -.
Obesity BMI > 35 - Decision: Refer; Loading: 25%+; pre-existing disease waiting: -.
Tobacco use (any form) - Decision: Accept; Loading: 15%; pre-existing disease waiting: -.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Occupation
content: Hazardous occupations (mining, offshore, armed forces combat roles, stunt work) are referred to the underwriter. All other occupations are accepted at standard rates.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Geography
content: Residents of all Indian states and union territories are eligible. Premium zone: Zone A (Mumbai MMR, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad) pays base rate; Zone B (all other cities) gets a 10% discount on base rate. Treatment anywhere in India is covered regardless of zone.

title: Sentinel Health - Underwriting & Qualification Rules (Internal) > Lead Qualification Criteria (for Tele-sales And Voice Agents)
content:
A lead is **Qualified** when all of the following are captured and acceptable:
- Age of oldest proposed member is within the plan's entry range.
- Number of members and relationship (self / spouse / children / parents).
- City or PIN code (to determine zone).
- Declared pre-existing disease do not fall in the Decline list.
- Desired sum insured is one of the available options.
- Customer agrees to a follow-up (quotation or callback).
A lead is **Referred** when a pre-existing disease requires underwriter review, when a hazardous occupation is declared, or when details are conflicting (for example a stated age that does not match the stated date of birth). Conflicts must be clarified with the customer; if they cannot be resolved on the call, mark the lead as Referred and do NOT promise eligibility.
A lead is **Not Eligible** when age is outside all plan ranges or a declared condition is in the Decline list. Agents must communicate this politely and offer to share information on the Senior Care plan where age-appropriate.
Agents must never state that a customer is "approved" or "guaranteed" cover. Eligibility is always preliminary and subject to underwriting.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Buying A Policy > Who Can Buy A Sentinel Health Policy?
content: Any Indian resident between 18 and 65 years of age can buy Essential or Family Shield. Senior Care is for people aged 61 to 80. Children from 91 days to 25 years can be covered as dependents under Family Shield. NRIs can buy a policy but treatment is covered only within India.

source.locator: Who Can Buy A Sentinel Health Policy?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Buying A Policy > Do I Need A Medical Test Before Buying?
content: If you are 45 or younger and have no pre-existing disease, no medical test is required - you can buy on the basis of your health declaration. If you are above 45, or you declare any pre-existing disease such as diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorder or asthma, we may ask for a pre-policy check-up. Sentinel pays for the test. Senior Care always requires a check-up.

source.locator: Do I Need A Medical Test Before Buying?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Buying A Policy > What Is A Pre-existing Disease (PED)?
content: A pre-existing disease is any condition, ailment or injury that was diagnosed, or for which medical advice or treatment was received, within 48 months before your first policy with us. pre-existing disease are covered after the pre-existing disease waiting period - 36 months on Essential and Family Shield, 12 months on Senior Care.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Buying A Policy > Have Diabetes. Can I Still Buy?
content: Yes, in most cases. Controlled Type 2 diabetes (HbA1c below 8) is accepted with a 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period and, depending on age, a premium loading of 10% to 25%. Insulin-dependent diabetes or diabetes with complications (kidney, eye or nerve damage) is referred to our underwriting team and may be declined.

source.locator: Have Diabetes. Can I Still Buy?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Buying A Policy > Can I Get Cover If I Smoke?
content: Yes. Smokers and tobacco users pay a loading of 15% on the base premium. You must declare tobacco use on the proposal form; non-disclosure can lead to claim rejection.

source.locator: Can I Get Cover If I Smoke?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Premiums And Payment > How Much Does It Cost?
content: Premium depends on plan, age of the oldest member, sum insured, city tier and any loadings. For example, a 30-year-old buying Sentinel Essential with Rs 5 lakh sum insured pays about Rs 7,200 a year plus GST. A family of two adults aged 35 and 33 with one child buying Family Shield Rs 10 lakh pays about Rs 18,900 a year plus GST. Ask our advisor for an exact quote.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Premiums And Payment > Can I Pay Monthly?
content: Yes. Annual, half-yearly, quarterly and monthly payment frequencies are available. Monthly payment carries a 4% frequency loading and requires auto-debit (NACH or card standing instruction).

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Premiums And Payment > What Happens If I Miss A Premium Payment?
content: You get a grace period of 30 days (15 days for monthly mode) to pay without losing continuity benefits. If you do not pay within the grace period, the policy lapses and any claim arising during the lapse period is not payable. Waiting periods restart if the lapse exceeds 30 days.

source.locator: What Happens If I Miss A Premium Payment?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Premiums And Payment > Will My Premium Increase Every Year?
content: Premium changes only when you move into a higher age band (every 5 years) or when IRDAI approves a revision of the product's rates. We do not increase an individual's premium because they made a claim.

source.locator: Will My Premium Increase Every Year?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Claims > How Do Cashless Claims Work?
content: Show your Sentinel health card at any network hospital. The hospital sends a pre-authorisation request; we usually approve within 2 hours for planned admissions and within 60 minutes for emergencies. At discharge we settle the bill directly with the hospital. You pay only non-covered items and any applicable co-payment.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Claims > How Do I Claim At A Non-network Hospital?
content: Pay the hospital, then submit the discharge summary, itemised bills, payment receipts, prescriptions and investigation reports through the Sentinel app or at a branch within 30 days of discharge. Reimbursement is credited to your bank account within 7 working days of receiving complete documents.

source.locator: How Do I Claim At A Non-network Hospital?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Claims > Why Do Claims Get Rejected?
content: The main reasons are: non-disclosure of a pre-existing disease at the time of buying, claims during a waiting period, treatment that is excluded (for example cosmetic surgery), hospitalisation that was not medically necessary, and incomplete documents. Sentinel's rejection rate is under 4%.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Policy Servicing > Can I Port My Existing Policy To Sentinel?
content: Yes. Under IRDAI portability rules you can move to Sentinel at renewal time and carry forward the waiting periods you have already served with your previous insurer. Apply at least 45 days before your current policy expires.

source.locator: Can I Port My Existing Policy To Sentinel?

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Policy Servicing > Can I Cancel After Buying?
content: You have a free-look period of 30 days from receiving the policy document. If you cancel within the free look, we refund the premium minus the cost of any medical tests and pro-rata risk premium for the days covered.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Policy Servicing > Is There A Co-pay?
content: Essential has a 10% co-payment on every claim. Family Shield has no co-payment unless a member was 61 or older at entry, in which case 20% applies to that member. Senior Care has a 20% co-payment, which can be removed with the co-payment Waiver rider.

title: FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions > Policy Servicing > What Is Not Covered?
content: Common exclusions: cosmetic or plastic surgery (unless after an accident), dental treatment unless caused by accident, infertility and IVF, treatment for alcohol or drug abuse, self-inflicted injuries, war and nuclear risks, experimental treatments, and expenses outside India. Please read the policy wording for the full list.

title: Sentinel Health Insurance > Health Cover That Actually Pays When It Matters
content: Sentinel Health Insurance has protected over 1.2 million members since 2011. cashless hospitalisation at 9,500+ network hospitals across India, claims settled in an average of 4 working days, and no-claim bonus of up to 50%.

source.locator: Health Cover That Actually Pays When It Matters

title: Sentinel Health Insurance > Health Cover That Actually Pays When It Matters > About Sentinel Health Insurance
content:
Sentinel Health Insurance Company Ltd. is a standalone health insurer licensed by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), registration no. 162. Our head office is in Pune, Maharashtra and we operate 84 branches and 1,100 partner outlets nationwide.
Our claim settlement ratio for FY 2023-24 was 96.4%. Claims are processed in-house; we do not use a third-party administrator (TPA), which is why our cashless pre-authorisation is typically approved within 2 hours.

title: Sentinel Health Insurance > Health Cover That Actually Pays When It Matters > Why Choose Sentinel?
content:
- cashless hospitalisation at 9,500+ network hospitals. Reimbursement is available at any registered hospital in India.
- Restoration benefit: if you exhaust your sum insured during the policy year, we restore 100% of it once for unrelated illnesses (Family Shield and Senior Care plans).
- no-claim bonus: sum insured increases by 10% for every claim-free year, up to a maximum of 50%.
- lifetime renewability - once you are a member, we never refuse renewal on grounds of age or claims history.
- Tax benefit under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act for premiums paid (as per prevailing tax laws).

title: Sentinel Health Insurance > Health Cover That Actually Pays When It Matters > How To Buy
content:
- Talk to a Sentinel advisor or request a call back.
- Complete the proposal form and tell us about your medical history honestly. Non-disclosure is the number one reason claims are rejected across the industry.
- Members above 45 years, or anyone declaring a pre-existing disease, may be asked for a medical check-up at a Sentinel-paid diagnostic centre.
- Pay the first premium. Your policy document is emailed within 24 hours and the 30-day initial waiting period begins from the policy start date.

title: Branch Partners > Become A Sentinel Branch Partner
content: Sentinel works with 1,100 partner outlets - banks, NBFCs, pharmacies and independent agencies - who distribute our health plans in their communities.

title: Branch Partners > Become A Sentinel Branch Partner > Branch Partnership Benefits
content: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. This includes a co-branded storefront kit, a tablet-based proposal app that issues policies in under 10 minutes, a dedicated relationship manager, and a shared marketing fund of up to Rs 1 lakh per outlet per year.

title: Branch Partners > Become A Sentinel Branch Partner > Commission Structure
content: Partners earn a first-year commission of 15% on Essential and Family Shield and 10% on Senior Care, with renewal commission of 7.5% from the second year onwards. Commission is paid monthly by the 10th of the following month.

title: Branch Partners > Become A Sentinel Branch Partner > Eligibility
content: Partners must hold a valid IRDAI corporate agent or POSP licence, have a physical outlet, and complete Sentinel's 2-day product certification. A minimum of 20 policies per quarter is expected after the first six months.

title: Branch Partners > Become A Sentinel Branch Partner > Contact The Partnerships Team
content: Write to [EMAIL] or call our partnerships desk on [PHONE] between 9:30 am and 6:00 pm, Monday to Saturday.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans
content: All plans cover in-patient hospitalisation (minimum 24 hours), day-care procedures, pre-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days and post-hospitalisation expenses for 90 days, road ambulance up to Rs 3,000 per hospitalisation, and AYUSH treatment at government-recognised hospitals.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans > Sentinel Essential
content: An affordable individual plan for young adults and first-time buyers. Sum insured options of Rs 3 lakh, 5 lakh and 7.5 lakh. Room rent capped at 1% of sum insured per day (ICU 2%). co-payment of 10% applies on every claim. No restoration benefit. Entry age 18 to 65 years.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans > Sentinel Family Shield
content: A family floater covering self, spouse and up to 4 dependent children (age 91 days to 25 years) under one sum insured. Options of Rs 5 lakh, 10 lakh, 15 lakh and 25 lakh. No room rent cap (any single private AC room). Zero co-payment for members below 61 years at entry. 100% restoration of sum insured once per year for unrelated illnesses. Maternity cover of Rs 50,000 per delivery after a 24-month waiting period (maximum 2 deliveries). Entry age 18 to 65 years for adults.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans > Sentinel Senior Care
content: Designed for parents and senior citizens aged 61 to 80 at entry. Sum insured options of Rs 3 lakh, 5 lakh and 10 lakh. Mandatory co-payment of 20% on all claims. pre-existing disease waiting period reduced to 12 months. Includes home-care (domiciliary) treatment up to 10% of sum insured and 100% restoration benefit. Pre-policy medical check-up is compulsory.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans > Plan Comparison
content:
Type - Essential: Individual; Family Shield: Family floater; Senior Care: Individual / 2-adult floater.
Entry age - Essential: 18-65; Family Shield: 18-65 (children 91 days-25 years); Senior Care: 61-80.
Sum insured (Rs) - Essential: 3L / 5L / 7.5L; Family Shield: 5L / 10L / 15L / 25L; Senior Care: 3L / 5L / 10L.
Room rent limit - Essential: 1% of SI per day; Family Shield: No limit (single private AC); Senior Care: Single private room.
co-payment - Essential: 10%; Family Shield: 0% (20% if entry age 61+); Senior Care: 20%.
Restoration - Essential: No; Family Shield: 100% once a year; Senior Care: 100% once a year.
Initial waiting period - Essential: 30 days; Family Shield: 30 days; Senior Care: 30 days.
pre-existing disease waiting - Essential: 36 months; Family Shield: 36 months; Senior Care: 12 months.
Specific illness waiting - Essential: 24 months; Family Shield: 24 months; Senior Care: 24 months.
Maternity - Essential: No; Family Shield: Rs 50,000 after 24 months; Senior Care: No.
no-claim bonus - Essential: 10%/years up to 50%; Family Shield: 10%/years up to 50%; Senior Care: 5%/years up to 25%.
Annual health check-up - Essential: After 1st year; Family Shield: After 1st year; Senior Care: Every year.

title: Plans > Our Health Insurance Plans > Optional Riders (add-ons)
content:
- Critical Illness Rider - lump sum payout of Rs 5 lakh to Rs 25 lakh on first diagnosis of any of 20 listed critical illnesses (cancer, heart attack, stroke, kidney failure, etc.). 90-day waiting period and 30-day survival period apply.
- Hospital Cash Rider - Rs 1,000 to Rs 3,000 per day of hospitalisation, from day 2, maximum 30 days a year.
- co-payment Waiver - removes the 20% co-payment on Senior Care for an additional premium of roughly 18%.
- OPD Cover - doctor consultations, diagnostics and pharmacy up to Rs 10,000 or Rs 20,000 a year.
Premiums are exclusive of GST at 18%. Premiums are subject to change with IRDAI approval. Rates shown on this page were last updated on 2024-04-01.

title: ShieldLife - Objection & FAQ Playbook (PH) > Escalation
content: Transfer to a licensed advisor / branch when the customer asks for a tao, a manager, a policy illustration PDF with signed figures, a complaint, or a product not in this knowledge base. Stay in their language - do not bounce into English.

title: ShieldLife × Banco Isla - Product Guide (Philippines)
content:
Bancassurance desk | Version 2.1 | Effective 2024-06-01 | Market: PH | Language: Filipino / English / Taglish
This is **not** a health-insurance document. ShieldLife is a life insurer distributing through Banco Isla branches.

title: ShieldLife × Banco Isla - Product Guide (Philippines) > ShieldLife Term Protect
content:
Term life with level premium. Coverage 5, 10, 15 or 20 years, or up to age 65. Sum insured ₱500,000 to ₱10,000,000. Medical exam required above ₱3,000,000 or age 50. No cash value. If the policy **lapses** after the 31-day grace period, coverage stops; reinstatement needs new underwriting within 2 years.
Premium example (non-smoker): 35-year-old male, ₱1,000,000, 20-year term ≈ ₱1,150 / month. Indicative only, exclusive of documentary stamp tax.

title: ShieldLife × Banco Isla - Product Guide (Philippines) > ShieldLife Whole Life
content:
Whole-life participating plan. Premiums payable to age 60 or 20 years, whichever later. Builds cash value after year 3. Optional **riders**: accidental death, waiver of premium, critical illness (20 conditions, 90-day waiting, 30-day survival). Beneficiary must be named; if none, estate.
"Magkano ang premium" depends on age, gender, smoker status, sum insured - never quote a number that is not on the rate card.

title: ShieldLife × Banco Isla - Product Guide (Philippines) > Credit Life (bank Referral)
content:
Credit life covers the outstanding Banco Isla personal loan or housing loan if the borrower dies. Distributed **only** as a bank referral from a Banco Isla relationship manager. Sum insured = outstanding principal, declining. Premium is added to the loan amortization, not billed separately.
Do not offer credit life to someone with no Banco Isla loan. Do not say the loan is "automatically approved" if they buy life insurance.

title: ShieldLife × Banco Isla - Product Guide (Philippines) > Bancassurance Conduct
content:
- Face-to-face or recorded call from a licensed advisor / AI qualifier is a solicitation.
- Customer may mix English and Filipino (Taglish). Answer in the same mix. Keep industry words: premium, policy, beneficiary, rider, lapse, coverage, bank referral.
- Politeness: po / opo with customers you do not know. Use first name only if they offer it.
- Amounts in pesos. Dates: "ika-15 ng buwan" or "15th of the month".

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi
content: Enablement 2024.4 | Bahasa formal + kolokial. Jangan terjemahkan playbook India.

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > Keberatan: "Dendanya Kejebak, Mahal."
content:
Disetujui: "Saya paham, Pak/Bu. Denda 0,5% per hari, max 3% sebulan, itu sesuai kontrak. Kalau Bapak bayar hari ini sebelum pukul 20.00, kita kunci denda yang sudah jalan saja - tidak nambah malam ini. Kalau masih berat, saya bisa minta petugas cabang tawarkan reschedule."
Jangan: hapus denda sendiri.

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > Keberatan: "DP-nya Terlalu Tinggi."
content: Disetujui: "Untuk MotorPlus bekas, DP 20% itu batas cabang. Motor baru bisa 10%. Turunkan tenor atau pilih unit lebih rendah kalau DP mau lebih kecil. Angka final setelah survey."

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > Keberatan: "Nanti Saja, Gaji Belum Masuk."
content: Disetujui: "Boleh. Jatuh tempo Bapak tanggal berapa? Saya setel pengingat dan callback sehari setelah gajian. Jangan sampai lewat tiga hari - denda mulai dihitung."

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > FAQ: Bisa Bayar Sebagian?
content: Bisa, tapi angsuran yang kurang tetap kena denda berdasar sisa. Tandai di sistem sebagai partial; petugas collections yang closing.

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > FAQ: Kalau Unit Rusak / Hilang?
content: Klaim asuransi kendaraan dulu (MotorPlus/MobilPlus). Cicilan tidak otomatis berhenti. Credit life bukan produk MitraDana.

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > Nada Jawa
content: Kalau nasabah bilang "Nggih Pak, monggo dicek tenornya," jawab: "Nggih, Pak. Tenor Bapak 36 bulan, angsuran Rp …, jatuh tempo tanggal … Mau saya bacakan cara bayar, monggo." Jangan: "Okay boss, let's check the loan ya."

title: MitraDana - Keberatan, FAQ, Dan Eskalasi > Eskalasi
content: Minta orang / petugas / cabang / komplain kasar / ancaman hukum → eskalasi dalam Bahasa Indonesia, jangan loncat ke Inggris.

title: MitraDana - Kepatuhan Panggilan
MitraDana - Kepatuhan Panggilan > Wajib Di Awal
content: Identitas (Sari, MitraDana), rekaman panggilan, tujuan (pengingat cicilan **atau** kualifikasi pembiayaan - jangan campur jadi teror).

title: MitraDana - Kepatuhan Panggilan > Dilarang
content:
- Ancaman kekerasan, malu di tempat kerja, atau menelepon keluarga tanpa izin.
- Menjanjikan "disetujui 100%" sebelum survey.
- Meminta PIN ATM, OTP, atau nomor kartu.
- Beralih ke bahasa Inggris ketika nasabah berbicara Bahasa.

title: MitraDana - Kepatuhan Panggilan > Data Yang Boleh Diambil
content:
Nama, usia, kota, nomor HP, nomor kontrak, tanggal jatuh tempo, jumlah angsuran, alasan telat. Masking PII di transkrip.
Contoh log: Ibu [NAME], Surabaya, HP [PHONE], kontrak [POLICY_NO], menunggak 12 hari.

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia)
content:
Versi 3.0 | Berlaku 1 Mei 2024 | Bukan terjemahan dari polis kesehatan India.
MitraDana adalah perusahaan pembiayaan (multifinance), bukan bank dan bukan asuransi jiwa.

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > DanaCepat (pembiayaan Dana Tunai)
content:
Pinjaman tanpa agunan. Plafon Rp 5 juta - Rp 50 juta. Tenor 6, 12, 18, 24 bulan. Bunga flat sesuai rate card cabang. **DP** tidak berlaku (karena bukan kendaraan). **Cicilan / angsuran** jatuh tempo setiap tanggal kontrak. **Denda** keterlambatan 0,5% per hari dari angsuran, maksimum 3% per bulan.
Contoh: plafon Rp 20 juta, tenor 12 bulan, angsuran sekitar Rp 2,05 juta / bulan (indikatif, belum termasuk biaya admin).

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > MotorPlus
content: Pembiayaan motor baru atau bekas (maks. 8 tahun). DP mulai 10% (baru) / 20% (bekas). Tenor 12-48 bulan. BPKB dipegang MitraDana sampai lunas. Asuransi kendaraan wajib.

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > MobilPlus
content: Pembiayaan mobil. DP mulai 20%. Tenor 12-60 bulan. Survey tempat tinggal + tempat kerja. Kalau nasabah menyebut **kendaraan kedua** ("mobil isteri", "motor dinas"), tawarkan multi-unit - itu sinyal cross-sell, bukan otomatis disetujui.

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > Pengingat Jatuh Tempo (bukan Teror)
content: Nada: sopan, Bapak/Ibu. Sampaikan sisa hari ke jatuh tempo, jumlah angsuran, cara bayar (alfamart, VA, cabang). Kalau nasabah kesulitan bayar: tawarkan reschedule / callback collections support. Dilarang ancam "kami datang malam ini".

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > Syarat Kualifikasi
content:
Qualified: WNI, usia 21-55 (pemohon), KTP sesuai domisili, penghasilan disesuaikan plafon, tidak masuk Daftar Hitam internal.
Referred: wiraswasta < 1 tahun, tenor 60 bulan MobilPlus, atau data KTP vs alamat konflik.
Not eligible: usia di luar rentang, unit di luar tahun maksimal, atau nasabah minta hapus denda tanpa wewenang cabang.

title: MitraDana Multifinance - Produk & Aturan Cicilan (Indonesia) > Regional (Jawa / Yogyakarta)
content: Nasabah bisa memakai "nggih", "monggo", "Pak". Balas dengan sopan, jangan tiba-tiba slang Jakarta atau bahasa Inggris. Istilah pembiayaan tetap: cicilan, tenor, denda, DP, jatuh tempo, angsuran, pembiayaan.
